travelers_cloak.name: Traveler's Cloak
travelers_cloak.desc: +3 Defense, +30 Max HP. Rough wool, a rope clasp and a hundred miles of road dust.

wolfpelt_mantle.name: Wolfpelt Mantle
wolfpelt_mantle.desc: +5 Defense, +20 Max HP. A short shoulder mantle of grey wolf fur, tusk-pinned.

crimson_warcape.name: Crimson Warcape
crimson_warcape.desc: +6 Defense, +60 Max HP, +3 Attack. A swallowtail battle cape edged in gold.

ranger_leafshroud.name: Ranger's Leafshroud
ranger_leafshroud.desc: +4 Defense, +0.3 Move Speed, +2% Crit Chance. Cut into leaves so it never snags.

frostweave_mantle.name: Frostweave Mantle
frostweave_mantle.desc: +9 Defense, +90 Max HP, 15% Ice Resist. Icicles hang from a hem that never thaws.

emberwing_cape.name: Emberwing Cape
emberwing_cape.desc: +6 Defense, +8 Attack, 15% Fire Resist. Its hem burns away into living flame.

ravenfeather_cloak.name: Ravenfeather Cloak
ravenfeather_cloak.desc: +5 Defense, +0.4 Move Speed, +15% Crit Damage. Layer on layer of black feathers with a violet sheen.

royal_ermine_mantle.name: Royal Ermine Mantle
royal_ermine_mantle.desc: +12 Defense, +160 Max HP, +60 Max MP. Imperial purple trimmed in spotted ermine, chained in gold.

starfall_cloak.name: Starfall Cloak
starfall_cloak.desc: +8 Defense, +120 Max MP, +10 Attack, 20% Dark Resist. A piece of the night sky, still turning.

stormbanner_cape.name: Stormbanner Cape
stormbanner_cape.desc: +10 Defense, +8 Attack, +8% Attack Speed, 20% Lightning Resist. A war banner with a zigzag hem that crackles in the wind.

dragonwing_cape.name: Dragonwing Cape
dragonwing_cape.desc: +14 Defense, +120 Max HP, +6 Attack, 10% Fire Resist. A folded drake wing, bone ribs and scalloped membrane.
